config.interpretation: Six warm states from three layouts, not six independent environments. Geometry and parameters are development choices, not fitted or validated STOP thresholds. No operational STOP rule is implemented.
config.confirmation_selection: Fixed before inference/results: first unused numeric test ID plus next two IDs after V1 50052751/752. No selection by model error or policy outcome.
config.success_description: Report paired endpoints on all states; structural benefit requires improvement over route_error on new layouts, not only over pointwise MapEx. No reranking of endpoints, model/threshold retuning or confirmation-map removal after observing results.
limits: New layouts are held out from this error estimator and policy development, not a verified new-building or LaMa-training holdout.
Risk is a cell error estimate from six correlated development states; its patch mean is only a heuristic weight, not P(full hypothesis true).
First-hit hard-map route scans and target-directed patch rays approximate visibility. The pathwise control is PIPE-inspired, not an exact PIPE implementation.
Counterfactual correction holds unseen predictions fixed; closed-loop LaMa changes may differ.
Three new layouts with two related states each are preliminary confirmation, not a statistical generalization claim.
